function.name: search_users
function.description: Search the user directory by name or email fragment.

query.description: Name or email fragment to match, case-insensitive.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return. Defaults to 10.

users.description: Matching users, each with user_id, name and email.

function.name: get_user
function.description: Retrieve a single user's profile by user id.

api_list.constraints: Returns an error when no user has the given id.

function.name: create_ticket
function.description: Open a new support ticket for a user.

reporter_id.description: User id of the person reporting the issue.

title.description: Short one-line summary of the issue.

ticket_id.description: Identifier of the newly created ticket.

api_list.constraints: The title must be non-empty. The reporter_id must refer to an existing user. Priority defaults to 'medium' when omitted.

function.name: get_ticket
function.description: Retrieve the full record of a ticket by id.

status.description: One of open, assigned, resolved or closed.

assignee_id.description: User id of the assignee, or null when unassigned.

comments.description: Comments on the ticket, newest last.

function.name: assign_ticket
function.description: Assign an open ticket to an agent.

ticket_id.description: Identifier of the ticket to assign.

assignee_id.description: User id of the agent taking the ticket.
User id now responsible for the ticket.

api_list.constraints: Only a ticket in status 'open' or 'assigned' can be assigned. Assigning a resolved or closed ticket returns an error.

function.name: add_comment
function.description: Append a comment to an existing ticket.

author_id.description: User id of the comment author.

ticket_id.description: Ticket the comment was added to.

function.name: resolve_ticket
function.description: Mark a ticket as resolved with a resolution note.

ticket_id.description: Identifier of the ticket to resolve.

resolution.description: Explanation of how the issue was resolved.

api_list.constraints: A ticket must be assigned before it can be resolved.

function.name: list_tickets
function.description: List tickets, optionally filtered by status or assignee.

status.description: Only return tickets in this status.

assignee_id.description: Only return tickets assigned to this user id.

limit.description: Maximum number of tickets to return. Defaults to 20.
